text:
maria: quick heads-up — i opened PR #4823: refactor payments TF modules, hoist root provider, and standardize k8s secret mapping. asking for a couple quick smoke checks before i merge.

maria: short description: move provider blocks to root, alias aws for legacy modules, unify secret path to `services/payments/credentials`, regen lockfile. no resource changes expected besides state move.

maria: validation steps i ran locally: 
```
TERRAFORM_ENV=staging make infra-plan
terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64
kubectl -n payments get secret payments-creds -o yaml | yq '.metadata.annotations["redwood.com/secret-path"]'
```

kevin: looks reasonable from the plan diff i skimmed. only a few `terraform state mv` operations showing provider address changes, no deletes. can you paste the exact `state mv` commands you ran?

maria: sure — i ran: 
```
terraform state mv module.payments.module.db_provider.aws_provider.aws module.aws
terraform state mv module.payments.aws_kms.aws_kms_key module.aws_kms
```

sam: CI passed for the tf plan job (ops-bot posted link). i ran the kube check — the secret still has the annotation but value unchanged. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: CI pipeline #4823/plan ✓ — artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/4823/plan (logs retained 7d)

lia: any risk of a rollout causing a brief credentials mismatch for payments? curious about the order: do we do state move then apply, or apply then move?

maria: order is state mv locally -> push lockfile+state-move steps in apply pipeline -> apply. doing state move first avoids terraform trying to recreate. no downtime expected if apply succeeds.

kevin: i can run the staging smoke tests after you merge. will check `kubectl -n payments rollout status deploy/payment-api` and do an auth smoke with test creds.

maria: thanks — can you also verify the secret annotation path: `redwood.com/secret-path: services/payments/credentials`? we use that for the secret-sync controller.

kevin: yep will check. pinging @sam to shadow.

sam: on it, i'll watch for any k8s secrets controller errors (`kubectl -n infra logs deploy/secret-sync`).

maria: one more tiny ask: update the module README with the provider alias snippet i added, so future authors don't reintroduce inline provider blocks. snippet: 
```
provider "aws" { alias = "legacy" region = var.region }
module "legacy_db" {
  source = "git::ssh://..."
  providers = { aws = aws.legacy }
}
```

lia: LGTM for documentation change.

maria: cool — i'll merge after kevin posts results. tagging this for post-merge follow-up: ensure `terraform providers lock` included in release notes and ops runbook.

kevin: staging checks done, rollout ok, secret annotation present, no errors in secret-sync logs. going to approve and merge.

maria: awesome, thanks all :tada:

kevin: small nit — we should add a CI linter check that flags inline provider blocks. filing a quick issue.

maria: agree — thank you!
